name: 摩美々
text:
普段使いするんだったら
今履いてる方……
trans:
If it's something for daily wear, go with the ones
you have now.

name: 摩美々
text:
でも、『新しい靴買った！』って
テンション上げたいならさっき履いた方……
trans:
But if you wanna flaunt some nice new shoes,
then go with the ones you tried on earlier.

name: 摩美々
text: ……いっそ、どっちもいったらぁ？

name: 結華
trans: No way, I'm on a tight budget!

name: 結華
text: ──ああ、めちゃめちゃ悩ませちゃってる
trans: ──Ugh, I'm really making them struggle with this.

name: 結華
text: 自分のためだけに相手の時間を使わせるこの感覚
trans:
It just feels wrong having them spend their day
putting up with me.

name: 結華
text: 申し訳なくて苦手……なんだけど
trans: I feel guilty... but at the same time...

name: 摩美々
text:
人が真剣に考えてるのに
へらへらしないでもらえますー？
trans:
We're trying to think this through over here.
Can you lose the goofy smile, please?

name: 結華
text:
ごめん！
あんまこういうことなかったから新鮮で！
trans:
My bad! I'm just not used to this sort of thing!
This is new to me!

name: 結華
text: ──今、ちょっと嬉しいって思ってるかもしれない
trans: ──I think... I'm getting a little happy from this.

name: 結華
text:
プロデューサー、こっち向かってくれてるけど
道が混んでてちょっと時間かかりそうだって
trans:
The producer's on his way, but he's stuck in traffic. 
We'll have to wait a bit.

name: 結華
text:
お茶でも飲んで待ってる？
それともお店見て回る？
trans:
Wanna grab something to drink in the meantime?
Or do you want to look around some more?

name: 摩美々
text: ロケだと入れなかったところがあってー
trans:
I didn't get a chance to look at stores since
we were busy with the shoot.

name: 霧子
text:
わたしも……
寄りたいとこ……あるの……
trans:
I also... have a place...
I want to see...

name: 摩美々＆霧子
trans:
Mamimi: And you, Mitsumine?
Kiriko: What about you, Yuika-chan?

name: 結華
text: 勇気出してみてよかったね
trans: Good thing I was brave enough to ask.

name: 結華
trans: ──────I still want to see the shoes..!

name: 摩美々
text:
はぁい
じゃ、それでー

name: 摩美々
trans: Hold on... What's got you all so fired up?

name: 結華
text:
な、なんとなく……！
靴への熱量？
trans:
N-No reason...!
Maybe I'm just really into shoes?

name: 摩美々
text:
……三峰が嫌じゃなければ、
これもありー
trans:
...This may not be what you're looking for,
Mitsumine, but these are an option too.

name: 摩美々
text: 目星つけてたやつとは違うケドー……
trans: Not my first pick for you, though...

name: 結華
text:
全然全然！
っていうか断然こっちじゃん！
trans:
No, it's fine!
These are waaay better!

name: 摩美々
text:
……ほんとにー？
気、遣ってないー？

name: 結華
text: 遣ってない遣ってない！

name: 結華
text:
……逆に大丈夫？
まみみんが密かに狙ってたやつだったりしない？
trans:
Are you sure about this, Mamimin? Aren't these
the ones YOU secretly had your eye on?

name: 摩美々
text:
や、しないからぁ
ムダな気遣い合戦反対ー
trans:
Not even. And fighting over who should get them
is pointless anyway.

name: 結華
text:
やった！
じゃあこれにしよー！
trans:
Yes!
M'kay, I'll buy these ones!

name: 結華
text: 付き合ってくれてありがとうね、ふたりとも！
trans: Thanks for sticking around, you two!
